Perfect! I've set up automatic sync recovery. Here's what you now have:

## **3 new files created:**

1. **`scripts/run-sync.ps1`** — Wrapper that runs your sync and logs all activity
2. **`scripts/setup-autostart.ps1`** — One-time setup script that creates Windows Scheduled Tasks
3. **`AUTOSTART.md`** — Setup and troubleshooting guide

## **To activate:**

Run this in PowerShell as Administrator:
```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup-autostart.ps1
```

## **What it does:**

- ✓ Runs sync **automatically on system startup** (no manual intervention needed after reboot)
- ✓ Runs sync **every 60 minutes** to keep data fresh and prevent multi-day gaps
- ✓ Logs all runs to `data/sync-runner.log` so you can verify it's working
- ✓ Uses SYSTEM account with highest privileges so it runs regardless of user login

The setup takes ~30 seconds, and sync will be active within minutes. You can customize the interval (30 min, 2 hours, etc.) by passing `-IntervalMinutes` to the setup script.
